admission.justification: The boundary is only real when the canonical role text, the operation text and its packaged serving copy all stop at the same place; one edited copy would let Bootstrap drift back into the foundation.

applicability: Bootstrap's setup conversation and its closing report, from memory-root choice to the handover instruction.
conditions: Memory root, baseline and settings are established and read back by Bootstrap itself.
The report ends by telling the user to start the Architect, and names c-14 as that continuation.
exclusions: Authoring onboarding, repairing citations, creating a task or starting a role.
Claiming that the knowledge foundation already happened.
statement: Bootstrap performs memory/baseline setup without onboarding authorship or citation repair and hands foundation work to a user-started Architect.
